resources.string: Measures how far you scroll and blurs apps when you owe a walk.

Scroll Debt measures the vertical distance you scroll in other apps (in metres) and shows a blurred layer over them when your scroll debt is high.\n\nIt only receives scroll and app-switch events. It cannot read what is on your screen, and nothing leaves your phone: the app has no internet permission.
